rules.title: Modbus Write Single Coil to Coil 1 from 10.10.10.30

detection_logic.summary: Detects Modbus TCP Write Single Coil requests targeting coil address 1 from 10.10.10.30 to the observed Modbus server 10.10.20.10:502.
detection_logic.suricata_rule: alert tcp 10.10.10.30 any -> 10.10.20.10 502 (msg:"JANUS OT Modbus Write Single Coil to coil 1"; flow:to_server,established; content:"|01 05 00 01|"; offset:6; depth:4; sid:1000001; rev:1;)

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Attack evidence fields data.function_code=5, data.coil_address=1, network.source_ip=10.10.10.30, network.destination_ip=10.10.20.10, and network.destination_port=502 identify a Modbus Write Single Coil request to coil 1.

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Attack evidence fields data.function_code=5, data.coil_address=1, network.source_ip=10.10.10.30, network.destination_ip=10.10.20.10, and network.destination_port=502 identify a second Modbus Write Single Coil request to coil 1.

evidence_references.label: baseline
evidence_references.relevance: Baseline evidence shows network.source_ip=10.10.20.30 communicating with network.destination_ip=10.10.20.10 on network.destination_port=502 using data.function_code=1 rather than the rule's source and Write Single Coil byte sequence.

expected_attack_result.expected_behavior: The rule is expected to match the two attack records with data.function_code=5 and data.coil_address=1 from 10.10.10.30 to 10.10.20.10:502.

expected_baseline_result.expected_behavior: The rule is expected to produce no matches because the referenced baseline records originate from 10.10.20.30 and use data.function_code=1.

limitations: The rule is limited to Modbus TCP traffic from 10.10.10.30 to 10.10.20.10 on TCP port 502.
The rule detects only Write Single Coil requests for coil address 1 and does not detect writes to other coil addresses or other Modbus write functions.
The rule depends on Suricata observing the client-to-server Modbus request bytes after TCP stream reassembly.

deployment_target.description: Suricata instance on the pfSense interface that observes IT-to-OT Modbus traffic
